fix: Where the phase's CLI exposes tool/function calling, have the agent emit the verdict via a tiny declared tool (phase, verdict, failure block) instead of appending a prose comment line; the bridge captures the structured call as the authoritative signal and the prose report stays human-facing. Keep the prose sentinel as the documented fallback for CLIs without tools (Strangler Fig, exactly like the existing sentinel-then-regex ladder). This removes the format-adherence failure class at the source for the CLIs that can support it, and removes the last-line fragility for everyone on that path.
notes: From the 2026-07-30 LLM-stability review §4.2. Ordering: contract-block-cli-escalation (0.9) is the compensating control and should land first — it works for every CLI; this item is the structural fix for the subset with tool support. | [RESEARCH UPDATE 2026-08-03] Anthropic shipped native constrained decoding for Claude (Nov 2025) — the July gap analysis ('unavailable on the tmux-CLI channel') is now HALF-stale: headless claude -p with structured outputs may enforce the verdict schema at the decode level. CAVEAT from the 2026 literature before going wide: the 'constraint tax' (arXiv 2606.25605) shows grammar masking can SUPPRESS tool-call tokens, and arXiv 2604.06066 documents structure-snowballing in constrained reflection — so constrain ONLY the terminal verdict emission (a separate small call after the agent turn), never the whole agentic turn. That is exactly this item's design; the research now names why it must stay narrow. EVIDENCE the prompt-side fix already works: two full batches 2026-08-03 with ZERO bad_verdict blocks on spine phases post-RenderContractTail — the decode-level layer is defense-in-depth for minted phases (the flake-rerun-scan template class), not a firefight.
summary: Constrained decoding (FSM token masking against a JSON schema) is the 2026 production standard for structured output and gives 100% schema-valid results — but it is unavailable to us: we drive interactive CLI REPLs under tmux, not raw APIs. Consequence, observed live: agy ignored the deliverable contract 7/7 times across corrections (its own report format, no machine verdict line), demoting the contract gate to advisory in both wave-1 lanes; and the sentinel being the LAST LINE OF PROSE is also what made the verify-read race visible as [bad_verdict] (cycle-1198).
title: Emit the machine verdict as a TOOL CALL where the CLI supports one — the available equivalent of constrained decoding
